question: In the United States, for Q4 2019 and Q4 2020, first select only those cities where total sales (with no promotions) rose by at least 20% from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020. Among these cities, rank products by their overall sales (still excluding promotions) in those quarters and take the top 20%. Then compute each top product’s share of total sales in Q4 2019 and Q4 2020 and calculate the difference in share from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020, returning the results in descending order of that share change.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT c.cust_city AS city, s.prod_id, t.calendar_year AS yr, s.amount_sold
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
    AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
    AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    AND s.promo_id IS NULL
),
city_sales AS (
  SELECT city,
    SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2019 THEN amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS s19,
    SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2020 THEN amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS s20
  FROM base
  GROUP BY city
),
qual_city AS (
  SELECT city
  FROM city_sales
  WHERE s19 > 0 AND s20 >= 1.2 * s19
),
prod_city AS (
  SELECT b.city, b.prod_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.yr = 2019 THEN b.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS p19,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.yr = 2020 THEN b.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS p20,
    SUM(b.amount_sold) AS ptot
  FROM base b
  JOIN qual_city qc ON b.city = qc.city
  GROUP BY b.city, b.prod_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT pc.city, pc.prod_id, pc.p19, pc.p20,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pc.city ORDER BY pc.ptot DESC) AS pr
  FROM prod_city pc
),
top AS (
  SELECT city, prod_id, p19, p20
  FROM ranked
  WHERE pr <= 0.2
),
citytot AS (
  SELECT b.city AS city,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.yr = 2019 THEN b.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS c19,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.yr = 2020 THEN b.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS c20
  FROM base b
  JOIN qual_city qc ON b.city = qc.city
  GROUP BY b.city
)
SELECT tp.city, tp.prod_id,
  (tp.p20 * 1.0 / ct.c20) - (tp.p19 * 1.0 / ct.c19) AS share_change
FROM top tp
JOIN citytot ct ON tp.city = ct.city
ORDER BY share_change DESC

WITH base AS (
  SELECT c.cust_city AS city, s.prod_id,
    CASE WHEN t.calendar_year=2019 THEN 'q19' ELSE 'q20' END AS q,
    s.amount_sold
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id=c.cust_id
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id=co.country_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id=t.time_id
  WHERE co.country_name='United States of America'
    AND t.calendar_quarter_number=4
    AND t.calendar_year IN (2019,2020)
    AND s.promo_id IS NULL
),
city_sales AS (
  SELECT city,
    SUM(CASE WHEN q='q19' THEN amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS s19,
    SUM(CASE WHEN q='q20' THEN amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS s20
  FROM base GROUP BY city
),
qual_city AS (
  SELECT city FROM city_sales WHERE s19>0 AND s20 >= 1.2*s19
),
prod_city AS (
  SELECT b.city, b.prod_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.q='q19' THEN b.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS p19,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.q='q20' THEN b.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS p20,
    SUM(b.amount_sold) AS ptot
  FROM base b JOIN qual_city qc ON b.city=qc.city
  GROUP BY b.city, b.prod_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT pc.city, pc.prod_id, pc.p19, pc.p20,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pc.city ORDER BY pc.ptot DESC) AS pr
  FROM prod_city pc
),
top AS (
  SELECT city, prod_id, p19, p20 FROM ranked WHERE pr <= 0.2
),
citytot AS (
  SELECT b.city AS city,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.q='q19' THEN b.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS c19,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.q='q20' THEN b.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS c20
  FROM base b JOIN qual_city qc ON b.city=qc.city
  GROUP BY b.city
)
SELECT tp.city, tp.prod_id,
  (tp.p20/ct.c20) - (tp.p19/ct.c19) AS share_change
FROM top tp JOIN citytot ct ON tp.city=ct.city
ORDER BY share_change DESC
